name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)

eligibility_rules.summary: Covers families identified under SECC 2011 database, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), and Priority Household (PHH) ration card holders across India.

covered_conditions.package_details: Hemodialysis package including dialyzer reuse, erythropoietin injections, and monthly nephrologist review. Fully cashless.
Covers PTCA stenting, Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG), valve replacement, pacemaker implantation, and emergency ICU stabilization.
High-risk institutional delivery, Caesarean section, neonatal nursery/NICU care for neonates, and postpartum complications.
Surgical resection, systemic chemotherapy cycles, targeted therapy, linear accelerator radiotherapy, and palliative supportive care.

name: Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana (MMJAY Bihar)
sponsor: Bihar Swasthya Suraksha Samiti (Govt of Bihar)

eligibility_rules.summary: Covers all NFSA ration-card holding families in Bihar who were omitted from the original 2011 SECC list, giving parity with PM-JAY benefits.

covered_conditions.package_details: Hemodialysis at district medical colleges and empanelled private centers across Bihar.
Stenting, bypass surgeries, and interventional cardiac treatments at IGIMS, AIIMS, and empanelled cardiac centers.
Emergency surgical deliveries and maternal intensive care in government & empanelled facilities.
Chemotherapy & surgical oncology at Mahavir Cancer Sansthan, IGIMS, and AIIMS Patna.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Arogya Karnataka (ArK)
sponsor: Suvarna Arogya Suraksha Trust (Govt of Karnataka)
coverage_limit: ₹5,00,000 / family (Cat A Eligible), up to ₹1,50,000 (Cat B General)

eligibility_rules.summary: Universal healthcare covering Category A (BPL/Eligible households - 100% cashless treatment up to ₹5 Lakh) and Category B (APL/General - 30% financial assistance at govt package rates).

covered_conditions.package_details: Free maintenance hemodialysis at INU, Victoria Hospital, KIMS, and taluk level dialysis centers.
Comprehensive cardiac intervention at Sri Jayadeva Institute and Narayana Health City without out-of-pocket costs for Cat A.
High-risk pregnancy care, C-sections, and neonatal care at Vani Vilas and Cheluvamba Hospitals.
Comprehensive multidisciplinary cancer therapy at Kidwai Memorial Institute of Oncology.
